UPDATE for your reply:
Being in denial of your work won’t change its outcome. Just seen your reply saying i was unsure of the colour i wanted WHEN i clearly showed you the work done last year and said i want something similar/close to. I booked the appointment days earlier for 3pm and you guys said it will be done by 7:30pm. I reached at 2:30pm. Instead of playing the victim game , acknowledging your mistake would have been better. All the best xx

As a tourist, my recent experience was very disappointing. I paid ₹8,000 for global colour and highlights, yet the results were thick, uneven, and orangey, done by an inexperienced stylist on my last day in Mumbai. This salon session left me nearly crying and saying “ next time you come we will do a discount”. Am not a cobaye.
My pedicure caused bleeding on my toe, and messages on Instagram were seen but ignored. Overall, this visit felt unprofessional and not worth the price.
*pics taken just after the salon session.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Jamilah,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We genuinely appreciate you taking the time to bring your concerns to our attention.

We understand your disappointment and would like to offer some clarity regarding your recent visit. During the consultation, there was some uncertainty about the exact hair color you wanted. Additionally, we noted that your hair had previously been treated with box dye at home, which made the color correction process more technically complex. Due to time constraints and your need to leave early, we were unable to complete the corrective work during your appointment.

Regarding the pedicure, our technician observed a significant buildup of hard, dead skin on your feet, which can sometimes result in minor scratches during exfoliation. We sincerely regret any discomfort caused and recommend applying an antiseptic cream to prevent irritation.

We also attempted to follow up via phone to discuss your concerns further. However, a male individual answered the call and informed us you would get back to us.

At Kuts and Kolor, our priority is always to provide not just great results, but a positive experience with complete client satisfaction. We’re here to support you with expert advice, quality care, and professional service every step of the way.

Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you'd like to schedule a follow-up appointment—we’d be happy to assist you further.

Warm regards,
Kuts and Kolor

I had an amazing experience getting my haircut here and I genuinely feel this is one of the best salon visits I’ve had in a long time. During the haircut, I could clearly see the precision and experience in their work. The sectioning, detailing, and finishing were done very carefully. They kept checking with me at different stages to make sure the length and shape were as I expected. I never felt ignored or hurried. The final result was exactly what I wanted — clean, stylish, and easy to manage. Even after washing at home, the haircut is sitting perfectly, which shows the quality of the technique. I’ve already received multiple compliments from friends and colleagues.

Pricing is fair for the quality of service you get, and the overall experience feels premium without being uncomfortable. I would definitely recommend this salon to anyone looking for a professional haircut with proper consultation and great service. I’ll surely be coming back again.
